quotes: “ He does n't bite , ”
“ May I give him a bone ? ”
“ Have you been long in Yalta ? ”
“ Five days . ”
“ And I have already dragged out a fortnight here . ”
“ Time goes fast , and yet it is so dull here ! ”

“ That 's only the fashion to say it is dull here . A provincial will live in Belyov or Zhidra and not be dull , and when he comes here it 's ‘ Oh , the dulness ! Oh , the dust ! ’ One would think he came from Grenada . ”
“ There 's something pathetic about her , anyway , ”
“ The weather is better this evening , ”
“ Where shall we go now ? Shall we drive somewhere ? ”
“ Let us go to your hotel , ”
“ What different people one meets in the world ! ”
“ It 's wrong , ”
“ You will be the first to despise me now . ”
“ How could I despise you ? ”
“ You do n't know what you are saying . ”
“ It 's awful . ”
“ You seem to feel you need to be forgiven . ”

“ Forgiven ? No . I am a bad , low woman ; I despise myself and do n't attempt to justify myself . It 's not my husband but myself I have deceived . And not only just now ; I have been deceiving myself for a long time . My husband may be a good , honest man , but he is a flunkey ! I do n't know what he does there , what his work is , but I know he is a flunkey ! I was twenty when I was married to him . I have been tormented by curiosity ; I wanted something better . ‘ There must be a different sort of life , ’ I said to myself . I wanted to live ! To live , to live ! . . . I was fired by curiosity . . . you do n't understand it , but , I swear to God , I could not control myself ; something happened to me : I could not be restrained . I told my husband I was ill , and came here . . . . And here I have been walking about as though I were dazed , like a mad creature ; . . . and now I have become a vulgar , contemptible woman whom any one may despise . ”
“ I do n't understand , ”
“ What is it you want ? ”
“ Believe me , believe me , I beseech you . . . ”

“ I love a pure , honest life , and sin is loathsome to me . I do n't know what I am doing . Some people say : ‘ The Evil One has beguiled me . ’ And I may say of myself now that the Evil One has beguiled me . ”
“ Hush , hush ! . . . ”
“ I found out your surname in the hall just now : it was written on the board — Von Diderits , ”
“ Is your husband a German ? ”
“ No ; I believe his grandfather was a German , but he is an Orthodox Russian himself . ”
“ There is dew on the grass , ”
“ Yes . It 's time to go home . ”
“ It 's a good thing I am going away , ”
“ It 's the finger of destiny ! ”
“ Let me look at you once more . . . look at you once again . That 's right . ”
“ I shall remember you . . . think of you , ”
“ God be with you ; be happy . Do n't remember evil against me . We are parting forever — it must be so , for we ought never to have met . Well , God be with you . ”
“ It 's time for me to go north , ”
“ High time ! ”
“ The part of a lady-killer does not suit you at all , Dimitri . ”
“ If only you knew what a fascinating woman I made the acquaintance of in Yalta ! ”
“ Dmitri Dmitritch ! ”
“ What ? ”
“ You were right this evening : the sturgeon was a bit too strong ! ”
“ One would run away from a fence like that , ”
“ How stupid and worrying it is ! ”
“ Here I 've had a good sleep for some reason . What shall I do in the night ? ”
“ So much for the lady with the dog . . . so much for the adventure . . . . You 're in a nice fix . . . . ”
“ It 's quite possible she may go to the first performance , ”
“ Good-evening . ”
“ Oh , heavens ! Why are these people here and this orchestra ! . . . ”
“ How you have frightened me ! ”
“ Oh , how you have frightened me ! I am half dead . Why have you come ? Why ? ”
“ But do understand , Anna , do understand . . . ”
“ I entreat you to understand . . . . ”
“ I am so unhappy , ”
“ I have thought of nothing but you all the time ; I live only in the thought of you . And I wanted to forget , to forget you ; but why , oh , why , have you come ? ”
“ What are you doing , what are you doing ! ”
“ We are mad . Go away to-day ; go away at once . . . . I beseech you by all that is sacred , I implore you . . . . There are people coming this way ! ”
“ You must go away , ”

“ Do you hear , Dmitri Dmitritch ? I will come and see you in Moscow . I have never been happy ; I am miserable now , and I never , never shall be happy , never ! Do n't make me suffer still more ! I swear I 'll come to Moscow . But now let us part . My precious , good , dear one , we must part ! ”
“ It 's three degrees above freezing-point , and yet it is snowing , ”
“ The thaw is only on the surface of the earth ; there is quite a different temperature at a greater height in the atmosphere . ”
“ And why are there no thunderstorms in the winter , father ? ”
“ Well , how are you getting on there ? ”
“ What news ? ”
“ Wait ; I 'll tell you directly . . . . I can n't talk . ”
“ Let her have her cry out . I 'll sit down and wait , ”
“ Come , do stop ! ”
“ Do n't cry , my darling , ”
“ You 've had your cry ; that 's enough . . . . Let us talk now , let us think of some plan . ”
“ How ? How ? ”
“ How ? ”
